tools.name: search_personas
tools.description: Search the authority.md marketplace. It carries three product types: persona thinking frameworks (e.g. Warren Buffett), functional Tools (e.g. Strategic Email — procedures for recurring tasks such as difficult emails, hiring, and pricing), and curated 10-persona Bundles (e.g. founder-stack, engineer

tools.name: get_persona_details
tools.description: Get the full details for a specific product on authority.md — a persona framework, a functional Tool, or a curated Bundle. Use after search_personas to show complete information before purchase. Returns metadata, a 'type' field, and a preview of the content. Accepts persona slugs (e.g. 'warren-buffe

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all categories of thinkers available on authority.md. Use when the user wants to browse by domain (Investor, Tech Visionary, Philosopher, etc.) rather than search by name.

tools.name: purchase_persona
tools.description: Generate a checkout URL on authority.md for purchasing one or more frameworks, Tools, or Bundles. Accepts 1-50 slugs (personas and/or Tools, mixed carts allowed). To purchase a Bundle, pass all 10 of its persona slugs (get them from get_persona_details on the bundle slug — they will land on the $29.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_persona" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Generate a checkout URL on authority.md for purchasing one or more frameworks, Tools, or Bundles. Accepts 1-50 slugs (personas and/or Tools, mixed carts allowed…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_personas, purchase_persona · Public sink: search_personas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_personas, purchase_persona · Public sink: search_personas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
